[P2] Distinguish transient files from configured session storage

The claim that replacement instances have no earlier files conflicts with `AgentcoreSessionConfig` in `packages/aws-durable-execution-sdk-js-extensions/src/compute/agentcore/types.ts`, which explicitly limits file loss to files outside configured session storage. Users configuring that storage receive contradictory persistence guidance. Qualify this paragraph and its idle-timeout recommendation as applying to process memory and transient files, preserving the configured-session-storage exception.
